article.story: No. 19 Missouri (3-0) at No. 24 Mississippi State (3-0), Sept. 26 at 7:45 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Mississippi State by 3.5. Against the spread: Mississippi State 3-0, Missouri 1-2. How to watch: SEC Network Key stats Mississippi State Offense Overall: 544.7 yards per game (2nd in FBS) Passing: 300.7 yards per game (23rd) Rushing: 244.0 yards per game (18th) Scoring: 47.0 points per game (10th) Mississippi State Defense Overall: 333.7 yards per game (69th in FBS) Passing: 233.7 yards per game (100th) Rushing: 100.0 yards per game (35th) Scoring: 20.0 points per game (57th) Missouri Offense Overall: 420.3 yards per game (61st in FBS) Passing: 246.7 yards per game (59th) Rushing: 173.7 yards per game (58th) Scoring: 39.7 points per game (32nd) Missouri Defense Overall: 258.7 yards per game (22nd in FBS) Passing: 171.0 yards per game (38th) Rushing: 87.7 yards per game (24th) Scoring: 17.3 points per game (41st) Missouri is 78th in third down percentage, converting 40.5% of the time. Mississippi State ranks 22nd on defense, allowing its opponents at convert at 27.7%. Missouri is 23rd in the FBS with a +3 turnover margin. Mississippi State is 126th in the FBS with 78.7 penalty yards per game. Missouri is 111th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 76.5% of trips. Mississippi State's red zone defense ranks 56th at 83.3%. Team leaders Mississippi State Passing: Kamario Taylor, 832 yards, 11 TDs, 1 INT, 68.3 completion percentage Rushing: Da'Marion Bothwell, 280 yards on 48 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Anthony Evans III, 294 yards on 20 catches, 3 TDs Missouri Passing: Austin Simmons, 635 yards, 8 TDs, 0 INTs, 68.7 completion percentage Rushing: Jamal Roberts, 300 yards on 63 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Donovan Olugbode, 268 yards on 17 catches, 4 TDs Last game Mississippi State defeated South Carolina 41-34 on Sept. 19. Taylor passed for 251 yards on 18-of-26 attempts (69.2%) with four touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball eight times for 33 yards. Bothwell carried the ball 21 times for 115 yards, adding one reception for 22 yards. Zion Ragins had two receptions for 61 yards and one touchdown. Missouri beat Troy 27-17 on Sept. 19. Simmons threw for 91 yards on 10-of-19 attempts (52.6%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. Roberts carried the ball 22 times for 128 yards and scored one touchdown, adding two receptions for 13 yards. Olugbode put up 31 yards on three catches with one touchdown. Next game Mississippi State hosts No. 8 Alabama on Oct. 3. Missouri hosts No. 21 Florida on Oct. 3.
